vendor: Wiz Inc. (subsidiary of Alphabet Inc. / Google Cloud, acquired March 2026)
product_family: Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP) combining Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management (CIEM), Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), vulnerability management, container/Kubernetes security, runtime protection, and AI Security Posture Management (AI-SPM). Multi-cloud enabled for AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.

certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type II audit demonstrating compliance with HIPAA/HITECH requirements. Third-party oversight of organization-wide security and privacy programs.

certifications.name: SOC 3
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 3 certification available in trust center documentation.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27001 certification audited on annual basis against industry standards. Information Security Management System (ISMS) standard.

certifications.proof_quote: CCPA compliance framework included in trust center certifications and continuous compliance coverage.

certifications.name: GovRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: GovRAMP certification available in trust center for government sector customers.

certifications.name: GDPR (Compliance Posture)

certifications.name: EcoVadis
certifications.proof_quote: EcoVadis rating October 2025 - Committed status. Environmental, social, and governance assessment.

certifications.name: CPSTIC Service High (France)
certifications.proof_quote: CPSTIC Service High certification for cloud security in France.

certifications.name: TruSight
certifications.proof_quote: TruSight certification available in trust center documentation.

privacy.ai_training_note: Wiz does not train on customer data. The platform applies best available models for security analysis. Wiz includes AI-SPM (AI Security Posture Management) for securing AI workloads. For integrations using the Wiz MCP Server, customers should review Google Cloud's data handling policies. Wiz focuses on privacy-first AI implementation with strict data governance for AI models and agents.
privacy.data_region: Multi-region support with data residency controls. Regional data processing available for compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and other regulatory frameworks. Specific regions available per customer agreement.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS/SSL encryption for all data transmission. Network security controls across multi-cloud environments.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Cloud-native encryption at rest. Data encrypted in cloud storage (AWS S3, Azure Blob, GCP Cloud Storage) using provider-native encryption.

security.name: Vulnerability management
security.value: Continuous vulnerability scanning and management integrated into CNAPP. Attack path analysis to identify exploitable risks.

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Third-party penetration test reports and red team assessments available in trust center. Annual recurring assessments.

security.name: Data security posture management
security.value: DSPM module for continuous discovery and classification of sensitive data (PII, secrets, IP). Data loss prevention and governance controls.

security.name: Runtime protection
security.value: eBPF-based runtime sensor for real-time threat detection and response. Cloud and AI runtime security.

security.name: Identity and access management
security.value: CIEM module for cloud infrastructure entitlement management. Least privilege access control and identity governance.

security.name: Incident response
security.value: Wiz Red agent for automated penetration testing and attack path discovery. Wiz Blue agent for threat hunting and investigation.

products.name: Cloud Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP)
products.data_scope: Multi-cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP, Oracle Cloud. Code, cloud infrastructure, runtime, and AI workloads.
products.notes: Core unified platform combining CSPM, CIEM, DSPM, vulnerability management, container security, and runtime protection. Agentless scanning. Graph-based context engine for attack path analysis.

products.name: Wiz for Government (FedRAMP High)
products.data_scope: U.S. government workloads. Handles FISMA high impact sensitive but unclassified data.
products.notes: FedRAMP High authorized product. Includes DSPM module. Designed for federal agencies and contractors. Available on AWS, with government-specific compliance controls.

products.name: AI Security Posture Management (AI-SPM)
products.data_scope: AI models, agents, training data, vector databases, MCP servers, and AI-related cloud infrastructure.
products.notes: Discovers AI models, agents, and services. Identifies AI-specific risks: guardrails, data exposure, exposed endpoints. Maps data access for models and agents. Privacy-first AI governance.

products.name: Wiz Green Agent (Auto-remediation)
products.data_scope: Code repositories, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code.
products.notes: AI-powered agent that automatically opens PRs to fix identified security issues at the source. Secure development workflow integration.

products.name: Wiz Red Agent (Offensive Security)
products.data_scope: Cloud environments, network paths, IAM configurations.
products.notes: Automated penetration testing and attack path discovery. Discovers lateral movement and privilege escalation paths.

products.name: Wiz Blue Agent (Threat Hunting)
products.data_scope: Cloud logs, runtime events, security findings.
products.notes: Automated threat hunting, investigation, and validation. Prioritizes real threats vs. noise.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription-based SaaS. Custom pricing per environment and use case. No per-agent fees (agentless architecture). Enterprise licensing available.
compare.data_residency: Multi-region support available. Data residency and sovereignty controls for compliance with regional requirements (GDPR, HIPAA, FedRAMP, etc.). Specific regions negotiated per customer contract.

flags: Wiz was acquired by Google Cloud and completed the acquisition on March 11, 2026. The privacy policy now redirects to Google Cloud's cloud acquisitions privacy notice. The product remains multi-cloud independent and not GCP-exclusive.
The CSA STAR Level 1 self-assessment from April 2025 is marked as deprecated (not renewed within the required timeframe).
FedRAMP High certification applies specifically to the 'Wiz for Government' product, not the base commercial CNAPP. Customers using the commercial Wiz product do not have FedRAMP certification.

The privacy policy URL redirects to Google Cloud; full privacy terms are now managed under Google's cloud acquisitions framework. Enterprise buyers should confirm DPA availability with Wiz sales for specific requirements.
Wiz operates as a modular CNAPP with multiple sub-products (Green/Red/Blue agents, AI-SPM). Buyers should confirm certification scope covers the specific modules used in procurement.
